title: Insects as Food
subtitle: 「昆蟲作食物」，究竟是哪一種說法？
description: 「昆蟲作食物」，究竟是哪一種說法？

words.note: 最直接、最常見的近義說法之一，指可供人食用的昆蟲，常見於營養、食品科技和可持續飲食討論。
words.example: Edible insects are increasingly studied as an alternative source of protein.
words.exampleZh: 食用昆蟲愈來愈常被研究作為替代蛋白質來源。

exercises.original: Researchers are studying insects as food as a possible source of sustainable protein.
exercises.zh: 研究人員正研究食用昆蟲作為可持續蛋白質來源的可能性。
exercises.upgrade: edible insects · 食用昆蟲

options.explanation: animal feed = 本句明確是 food，且後文談人類替代蛋白來源。
pests = 害蟲分類和可食用性是不同概念。
edible insects = possible source of sustainable protein 直接指可供食用的昆蟲，因此 edible insects 最自然。
bugs = 太口語，不適合 research context。
protein = 只是營養成分，不是食品類別。
entomology = 是研究昆蟲的學科，不是食物。

exercises.original: The exhibition introduces visitors to insects as food from different cultures.
exercises.zh: 展覽向參觀者介紹不同文化中的食用昆蟲。
exercises.upgrade: edible insects · 食用昆蟲

options.explanation: insect feed = 不是人類飲食文化。
pests = 不合。
entomology = 不是展示學科本身。
edible insects = 跨文化介紹可供人吃的 insects，edible insects 最直接。
animal feed = 方向錯誤。
protein supplements = 範圍不同。

exercises.original: Several restaurants have begun experimenting with insects as food.
exercises.zh: 數間餐廳開始嘗試使用食用昆蟲。
exercises.upgrade: edible insects · 食用昆蟲

options.explanation: animal feed = 餐廳不是製作動物飼料。
pests = 不合 food service。
entomology = 不合。
bugs = 過於口語且不夠精確。
edible insects = restaurants 實際把昆蟲作食材，edible insects 最自然。
protein = 不是具體食材類別。

words.meaning: 昆蟲製食品；以昆蟲為原料的食品
words.note: 強調食品是以昆蟲或昆蟲成分製成，例如昆蟲粉、能量棒或烘焙產品。
words.example: The company develops insect-based food for consumers seeking alternative proteins.
words.exampleZh: 這家公司開發以昆蟲為原料的食品，供尋找替代蛋白質的消費者選擇。

exercises.original: The company is developing insects as food in the form of protein bars and pasta.
exercises.zh: 公司正在開發以昆蟲為原料的食品，例如蛋白棒和意粉。
exercises.upgrade: insect-based food · 昆蟲製食品；以昆蟲為原料的食品

options.explanation: edible insects = 可食用昆蟲是原料本身，而 protein bars/pasta 已是加工食品。
animal feed = 本句產品是人類食品。
entomophagy = 是食用行為，不是產品。
insect-based food = protein bars 和 pasta 是以昆蟲成分製成的加工食品，因此 insect-based food 最精確。
pests = 不合。
insect-borne food = 意思錯誤，會變成『由昆蟲傳播』。

exercises.original: The supermarket created a small section for insects as food, including crackers made with cricket powder.
exercises.zh: 超級市場設立小型專區售賣以昆蟲為原料的食品，包括加入蟋蟀粉的餅乾。
exercises.upgrade: insect-based food · 昆蟲製食品；以昆蟲為原料的食品

options.explanation: edible insects = 若是整隻昆蟲可用，但 crackers 是加工食品。
animal feed = 不合超市人類食品專區。
protein = 太廣。
entomology = 不合。
insect-based food = crackers made with cricket powder 明確是 insect-based processed food。
pests = 不合。

exercises.original: Consumer attitudes toward insects as food may depend on how the products are presented.
exercises.zh: 消費者對昆蟲製食品的態度可能取決於產品如何呈現。
exercises.upgrade: insect-based food · 昆蟲製食品；以昆蟲為原料的食品

options.explanation: edible insects = 也接近，但 products are presented 更突出食品產品形式。
animal feed = 不合 consumers 人類食品語境。
bugs = 過於口語。
protein = 不等於完整產品類別。
entomophagy = 是行為／文化實踐，不是產品。
insect-based food = 句子談 consumer products 的呈現方式，因此 insect-based food 很自然。

words.meaning: 昆蟲製食品；以昆蟲為原料的各類食品
words.note: 複數形式，常用於討論整個食品類別，包括使用昆蟲粉、昆蟲蛋白或整隻昆蟲製成的產品。
words.example: Insect-based foods are appearing in some specialist food markets.
words.exampleZh: 一些專門食品市場開始出現以昆蟲為原料的食品。

exercises.original: Researchers compared several types of insects as food sold in specialty stores.
exercises.zh: 研究人員比較專門商店出售的數類昆蟲製食品。
exercises.upgrade: insect-based foods · 昆蟲製食品；以昆蟲為原料的各類食品

options.explanation: edible insects = 若比較的是整隻 insect species 才較合適；本句說 types of foods。
animal feeds = 不合 specialty food stores。
pests = 不合。
entomology products = 不是自然說法。
insect-based foods = several types + sold in stores 表示多種食品產品，複數 insect-based foods 最自然。
proteins = 會把產品類型縮窄成營養素。

exercises.original: The report examines how insects as food are labelled and marketed.
exercises.zh: 報告研究昆蟲製食品如何被標籤和推廣。
exercises.upgrade: insect-based foods · 昆蟲製食品；以昆蟲為原料的各類食品

options.explanation: entomophagy = 行為不能被 labelled and marketed 作商品。
animal feed = 不一定是人類食品。
pests = 不合。
bugs = 太口語。
protein sources = 較廣且不是產品類別。
insect-based foods = labelled and marketed 是產品類別語境，因此 insect-based foods 最精確。

exercises.original: Some consumers are more willing to try insects as food when the insects are not visible.
exercises.zh: 當看不到昆蟲原形時，一些消費者更願意嘗試昆蟲製食品。
exercises.upgrade: insect-based foods · 昆蟲製食品；以昆蟲為原料的各類食品

options.explanation: insect-based foods = insects are not visible 表示食品已加工，故 insect-based foods 最自然。
edible insects = 若 insects not visible，代表通常已加工成產品，insect-based foods 更精確。
animal feed = 不合。
pests = 不合。
entomology = 不合。
bugs = 不是正式產品術語。

words.note: 當 insects as food 的重點是營養價值，尤其是蛋白質來源時可用；語義比原詞更窄。
words.example: Researchers are examining insect protein as a possible ingredient in animal and human food.
words.exampleZh: 研究人員正在研究昆蟲蛋白作為動物和人類食品成分的可能性。

exercises.original: Many studies discuss insects as food because of their high protein content.
exercises.zh: 很多研究因昆蟲蛋白含量高而討論昆蟲作食品的用途。
exercises.upgrade: insect protein · 昆蟲蛋白

options.explanation: animal feed = 可能含 insect protein，但本句聚焦營養成分本身。
entomophagy = 是行為，不是 nutrient source。
pests = 不合。
insect-borne protein = 語義錯誤。
bugs = 不合正式 nutrition context。
insect protein = 當焦點由整個食品轉到其 protein value，insect protein 最精確。

exercises.original: The manufacturer is testing insects as food as an ingredient in high-protein snacks.
exercises.zh: 製造商正測試昆蟲蛋白作為高蛋白零食的成分。
exercises.upgrade: insect protein · 昆蟲蛋白

options.explanation: insect protein = ingredient in high-protein snacks 使營養成分角度非常明確，因此 insect protein 很自然。
edible insects = 若是整隻昆蟲可用，但 as an ingredient 更像提取或加工 protein。
animal feed = 不合 human snacks。
entomophagy = 不是 ingredient。
pests = 不合。
insect-borne material = 意思錯誤。

exercises.original: Scientists are evaluating insects as food for their amino-acid profile.
exercises.zh: 科學家正評估昆蟲蛋白的氨基酸組成。
exercises.upgrade: insect protein · 昆蟲蛋白

options.explanation: edible insects = 整隻昆蟲也有 amino-acid profile，但句子焦點是 protein fraction。
insect protein = amino-acid profile 是蛋白質營養分析線索，因此 insect protein 最精確。
animal feed = 不合。
entomology = 不是營養成分。
pests = 不合。
food bugs = 不正式。

words.note: 較正式，指由昆蟲或昆蟲成分製成的食品，常見於食品科技、法規和產品分類語境。
words.example: The regulation sets labelling requirements for insect-derived food.
words.exampleZh: 該規例為昆蟲來源食品訂立標籤要求。

exercises.original: The regulation sets new labelling rules for insects as food.
exercises.zh: 該規例為昆蟲來源食品訂立新的標籤規則。
exercises.upgrade: insect-derived food · 昆蟲來源食品

options.explanation: insect-derived food = regulation + labelling rules 是正式食品分類語境，insect-derived food 很精確。
entomophagy = 食用行為不會有 product labelling。
animal feed = 若規例是 human food，範圍錯誤。
pests = 不合。
bugs = 不適合法規語體。
protein = 範圍太窄。

exercises.original: Food-safety authorities issued guidance on insects as food and their ingredients.
exercises.zh: 食品安全部門就昆蟲來源食品及其成分發布指引。
exercises.upgrade: insect-derived food · 昆蟲來源食品

options.explanation: edible insects = 可用但不如 derived food 涵蓋加工成分。
insect-derived food = food-safety authorities 和 ingredients 支持正式術語 insect-derived food。
animal feed = 不是 human food-safety context。
entomology = 不合。
pests = 不合。
insect-borne food = 會表示昆蟲傳播污染或疾病，意思錯。

exercises.original: The study examined consumer acceptance of insects as food in processed products.
exercises.zh: 研究探討消費者對加工產品中昆蟲來源食品的接受程度。
exercises.upgrade: insect-derived food · 昆蟲來源食品

options.explanation: edible insects = 較偏整隻／可食用昆蟲本身。
entomophagy = 是 eating practice，不是 product category。
insect-derived food = processed products 表明昆蟲成分被衍生成食品，因此 insect-derived food 很自然。
animal feed = 不合 consumer human food context。
pests = 不合。
protein = 太窄。

words.meaning: 昆蟲食品產品；昆蟲製品
words.note: 較廣泛，指以昆蟲為原料的食品產品；在食品語境下可包括粉末、零食、蛋白棒等。
words.example: The retailer introduced several insect products in its alternative-protein section.
words.exampleZh: 零售商在替代蛋白質專區引入數款昆蟲食品產品。

exercises.original: The retailer added several insects-as-food items to its alternative-protein range.
exercises.zh: 零售商在替代蛋白質產品系列中加入數款昆蟲食品產品。
exercises.upgrade: insect products · 昆蟲食品產品；昆蟲製品

options.explanation: pests = 不是零售商品類別。
insect products = retailer + range + items 表示商品類別，因此 insect products 很自然。
animal feeds = 不合 human retail range。
entomophagy = 不是可數 products。
insect studies = 不是商品。
followers = 完全無關。

exercises.original: The trade fair displayed insects as food from several manufacturers.
exercises.zh: 展覽會展示多家製造商的昆蟲食品產品。
exercises.upgrade: insect products · 昆蟲食品產品；昆蟲製品

options.explanation: edible insects = 如果全部是整隻昆蟲才合適，但 manufacturers 暗示多種產品形態。
animal feed = 未必是人類食品。
insect products = trade fair 展示 manufacturers 的多種商品，insect products 最貼切。
entomophagy = 不是 displayable product。
pests = 不合。
protein = 太窄。

exercises.original: Sales of insects as food remain small compared with conventional snacks.
exercises.zh: 昆蟲食品產品的銷售與傳統零食相比仍然很少。
exercises.upgrade: insect products · 昆蟲食品產品；昆蟲製品

options.explanation: entomophagy = 不能說 sales of a practice。
pests = 不合。
animal feed = 比較 conventional snacks 顯示是人類食品。
insect products = sales + product comparison 最適合 insect products。
edible insects = 可用但 product sales 語境較窄。
insect-borne goods = 意思錯。

words.meaning: 昆蟲基產品；以昆蟲為原料的產品
words.note: 較正式、較廣，可指食品，也可能包括飼料或其他產品；在明確 food context 中可自然對應。
words.example: The start-up sells insect-based products such as protein bars and baking flour.
words.exampleZh: 這間初創公司銷售昆蟲基產品，例如蛋白棒和烘焙粉。

exercises.original: The start-up sells insects as food such as protein bars and baking flour.
exercises.zh: 這間初創公司銷售以昆蟲為原料的產品，例如蛋白棒和烘焙粉。
exercises.upgrade: insect-based products · 昆蟲基產品；以昆蟲為原料的產品

options.explanation: edible insects = bars/flour 不是整隻 insects。
animal feed = 不合例子。
insect-based products = 列出的 bars 和 flour 都是以昆蟲為原料的加工產品，因此 insect-based products 最精確。
entomophagy = 不是 products。
pests = 不合。
protein only = baking flour 不一定只是純 protein。

exercises.original: The company plans to expand its range of insects as food next year.
exercises.zh: 公司計劃明年擴大其昆蟲基產品系列。
exercises.upgrade: insect-based products · 昆蟲基產品；以昆蟲為原料的產品

options.explanation: edible insects = 若是 species range 可用，但 range of products 更自然。
animal feeds = 未必。
entomophagy = 不能形成 product range。
insect-based products = expand its range 是典型產品線語境，因此 insect-based products 很自然。
pests = 不合。
bugs = 太口語。

exercises.original: Packaging design may affect whether consumers are willing to buy insects as food.
exercises.zh: 包裝設計可能影響消費者是否願意購買昆蟲基產品。
exercises.upgrade: insect-based products · 昆蟲基產品；以昆蟲為原料的產品

options.explanation: edible insects = packaging 也可用，但如果是不同加工商品，products 更完整。
animal feed = 不合一般 consumers。
entomophagy = 不能 buy a practice。
pests = 不合。
insect-based products = packaging design + buy 明確是 retail product 語境。
insect-borne products = 語義錯誤。

words.note: 非常清楚的描述性說法，適合一般讀者和需要避免技術術語的語境。
words.example: The documentary explores how food made from insects is produced and marketed.
words.exampleZh: 這部紀錄片探討由昆蟲製成的食物如何生產和推廣。

exercises.original: The documentary explains how insects as food are produced for modern consumers.
exercises.zh: 這部紀錄片解釋供現代消費者食用的昆蟲食品如何生產。
exercises.upgrade: food made from insects · 由昆蟲製成的食物

options.explanation: animal feed = 本句明確是 consumers。
entomology = 不是 food production。
pests = 不合。
food made from insects = 需要用一般讀者容易理解的說法時，food made from insects 清楚直接。
insect-borne food = 意思是由昆蟲傳播問題，不是昆蟲製食品。
protein = 過於狹窄。

exercises.original: Some people are more open to insects as food when they are used in familiar recipes.
exercises.zh: 當昆蟲被用於熟悉食譜時，有些人較願意接受由昆蟲製成的食物。
exercises.upgrade: food made from insects · 由昆蟲製成的食物

options.explanation: entomophagy = 重點不是 eating culture，而是 food form。
animal feed = 不合。
pests = 不合。
edible insects = 若 insects 被混入 recipe，描述 processed food 更自然。
food made from insects = used in familiar recipes 指以昆蟲作原料製成 food，因此描述性說法最自然。
bugs = 太口語。

exercises.original: The article gives examples of insects as food, including bread made with cricket powder.
exercises.zh: 文章列出由昆蟲製成的食物例子，包括加入蟋蟀粉的麵包。
exercises.upgrade: food made from insects · 由昆蟲製成的食物

options.explanation: edible insects = bread 不是 insect 本身。
animal feed = 不合。
entomophagy = 不是 examples of products。
pests = 不合。
insect-borne food = 語義錯誤。
food made from insects = bread with cricket powder 是典型 food made from insects。

words.note: 較正式，常見於食品安全、法規、農業和研究語境，強調昆蟲是供人食用而不是作飼料。
words.example: The study focuses on insects for human consumption rather than animal feed.
words.exampleZh: 這項研究集中於供人類食用的昆蟲，而不是動物飼料。

exercises.original: The study focuses on insects as food rather than insects used in animal feed.
exercises.zh: 研究集中於供人類食用的昆蟲，而不是用於動物飼料的昆蟲。
exercises.upgrade: insects for human consumption · 供人類食用的昆蟲

options.explanation: edible insects = 也可以，但和 animal feed 對比時 human consumption 更正式明確。
pests = 不合。
entomology = 不合。
protein = 不是昆蟲本身。
insects for human consumption = rather than ... animal feed 明確需要區分人食與飼料用途，因此 insects for human consumption 最精確。
insect feed = 方向混亂。

exercises.original: Regulators are developing safety standards for insects as food.
exercises.zh: 監管機構正為供人類食用的昆蟲制定安全標準。
exercises.upgrade: insects for human consumption · 供人類食用的昆蟲

options.explanation: bugs = 不適合法規語境。
pests = 不合。
animal feed = 用途不同。
entomophagy = 不是受規管食品本體。
protein = 太窄。
insects for human consumption = regulators + safety standards 是正式食品法規語境，因此 insects for human consumption 很自然。

exercises.original: Farmers producing insects as food must follow strict hygiene rules.
exercises.zh: 生產供人類食用昆蟲的農戶必須遵守嚴格衛生規則。
exercises.upgrade: insects for human consumption · 供人類食用的昆蟲

options.explanation: insects for human consumption = strict hygiene rules + production purpose 清楚指 human food chain。
animal feed = 如果只是 feed，衛生規則會屬不同用途標準。
pests = 不合。
entomology = 不合。
bugs = 太口語。
protein supplements = 不是 farms producing insects 本身。

words.note: 專業術語，指人類食用昆蟲這種行為或文化實踐；不是指某一種食品本身。
words.example: Entomophagy has a long history in many parts of the world.
words.exampleZh: 在世界許多地區，食蟲都有悠久歷史。

exercises.original: The article examines insects as food as a long-standing practice in several cultures.
exercises.zh: 文章探討數種文化中歷史悠久的食蟲習慣。
exercises.upgrade: entomophagy · 食蟲；食用昆蟲的習慣

options.explanation: edible insects = 是食品本身，不是 practice。
animal feed = 不合文化飲食習慣。
entomology = 是昆蟲學，不是吃昆蟲。
pests = 不合。
insect products = 不是 practice。
entomophagy = long-standing practice in several cultures 明確指食用昆蟲這種行為，因此 entomophagy 最精確。

exercises.original: Researchers studied attitudes toward insects as food in communities where eating insects is traditional.
exercises.zh: 研究人員研究在傳統食蟲社群中對食蟲的態度。
exercises.upgrade: entomophagy · 食蟲；食用昆蟲的習慣

options.explanation: entomophagy = 當焦點是 eating insects 這種文化實踐，專業術語是 entomophagy。
entomology = 研究昆蟲學和研究食蟲態度不同。
edible insects = 可研究對食材態度，但這句明確說 eating insects is traditional。
animal feed = 不合。
pests = 不合。
insect flour = 太具體。

exercises.original: Public acceptance of insects as food varies widely between regions.
exercises.zh: 不同地區對食蟲的接受程度差異很大。
exercises.upgrade: entomophagy · 食蟲；食用昆蟲的習慣

options.explanation: entomology = 不是科學學科接受度。
entomophagy = 比較不同地區對食用昆蟲這種 practice 的接受程度，entomophagy 很精確。
animal feed = 不合。
pests = 不合。
insect products = 如果比較產品接受度可用，但這句是整體 practice。
protein = 不合。

words.note: 當 insects as food 具體指烘烤、調味或加工成零食的昆蟲產品時適用；語義更窄。
words.example: The shop sells insect snacks made from roasted crickets.
words.exampleZh: 這家商店售賣以烤蟋蟀製成的昆蟲零食。

exercises.original: The shop sells insects as food, including roasted crickets with different seasonings.
exercises.zh: 這家商店售賣昆蟲零食，包括不同口味的烤蟋蟀。
exercises.upgrade: insect snacks · 昆蟲零食

options.explanation: insect snacks = roasted crickets with seasonings 明確是 snack format，因此 insect snacks 最自然。
animal feed = 不合商店零食。
entomophagy = 不是商品。
pests = 不合。
insect flour = 不是 roasted whole crickets。
protein = 太廣。

exercises.original: Festival visitors could sample insects as food from small packets.
exercises.zh: 節慶參加者可以試食小包裝昆蟲零食。
exercises.upgrade: insect snacks · 昆蟲零食

options.explanation: edible insects = 也接近，但 small packets + sample 更像 packaged snacks。
insect snacks = small packets + sample 表示零食產品，因此 insect snacks 很精確。
animal feed = 不合。
entomology = 不合。
pests = 不合。
insect flour = 不是粉末。

exercises.original: The company markets insects as food as a crunchy alternative to conventional snacks.
exercises.zh: 公司把昆蟲零食推廣為傳統零食的香脆替代品。
exercises.upgrade: insect snacks · 昆蟲零食

options.explanation: animal feed = 不合。
entomophagy = 不能被 marketed as crunchy。
insect snacks = crunchy alternative to conventional snacks 直接支持 insect snacks。
insect flour = 不是 crunchy snack 本身。
pests = 不合。
protein = 只是營養素。

words.note: 當昆蟲被磨成粉並用於烘焙或加工食品時適用，常見於產品開發和替代蛋白語境。
words.example: The bakery tested insect flour in a high-protein cracker recipe.
words.exampleZh: 麵包店測試在高蛋白餅乾配方中使用昆蟲粉。

exercises.original: The bakery is testing insects as food in bread by using finely ground cricket powder.
exercises.zh: 麵包店正以細磨蟋蟀粉測試昆蟲粉在麵包中的應用。
exercises.upgrade: insect flour · 昆蟲粉；昆蟲麵粉

options.explanation: edible insects = 整隻 insects 不是這裡的形態。
insect flour = finely ground cricket powder 是 insect flour 的直接線索。
insect snacks = 不是零食成品。
animal feed = 不合 bakery。
entomophagy = 不是 ingredient。
pests = 不合。

exercises.original: Researchers added insects as food to cracker dough in powdered form.
exercises.zh: 研究人員以粉末形式把昆蟲粉加入餅乾麵糰。
exercises.upgrade: insect flour · 昆蟲粉；昆蟲麵粉

options.explanation: edible insects = 未直接加入整隻 insects。
insect protein = 可能是其中成分，但 powdered form + dough 更自然是 flour。
insect flour = 加入 dough 的粉狀昆蟲原料，最自然稱 insect flour。
animal feed = 不合。
entomophagy = 不合 ingredient。
insect snacks = crackers 才是最終 snack。

exercises.original: The recipe replaces part of the wheat flour with insects as food to increase protein content.
exercises.zh: 這個食譜以昆蟲粉取代部分小麥粉，以提高蛋白質含量。
exercises.upgrade: insect flour · 昆蟲粉；昆蟲麵粉

options.explanation: edible insects = 不是直接替代 flour 的整隻昆蟲。
insect protein = 也可能提高蛋白質，但句法是 replacing flour with another flour-like ingredient。
animal feed = 不合人類食譜。
insect flour = replaces part of the wheat flour 明確要求 flour-like ingredient，因此 insect flour 最精確。
entomophagy = 不是食材。
pests = 不合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 昆蟲飼料不等於供人食用的昆蟲 insect feed 通常指給昆蟲吃的飼料，或在某些語境指以昆蟲製成的動物飼料；不是一般的人類食品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Food for humans made from insects is different from feed used for animals or insects.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動物飼料不等於人類食品 animal feed 是給動物食用的飼料；即使含昆蟲成分，也不能等同於 insects as food for humans。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Insect protein can be used in animal feed as well as in some foods for people.

falseSynonyms.zh: 害蟲不等於食用昆蟲 pest 是對農作物、建築或人類活動造成損害的生物分類；可食用昆蟲不等於害蟲。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An insect can be edible without being considered a pest.

falseSynonyms.zh: 蟲子的口語稱呼不等於食品類別 bug 是較口語、模糊的稱呼；在食品、科研或法規語境中通常需要更精確的 insect。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON People may casually say bugs, but food labels and research usually use more precise terms.

falseSynonyms.zh: 蛋白質不等於昆蟲食品 protein 是營養素；昆蟲可以是蛋白質來源，但 insects as food 包括的概念更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Insects may provide protein, but protein itself is not the same as insect-based food.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可食用與食用昆蟲不同 edible 只是形容詞，表示可安全食用；edible insects 才是具體食品類別。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A plant can be edible too; edible insects specifically refers to insects suitable for eating.

falseSynonyms.zh: 昆蟲學與食蟲不同 entomology 是研究昆蟲的科學；entomophagy 是食用昆蟲的行為或習慣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Entomology studies insects; entomophagy means eating insects.

falseSynonyms.zh: 昆蟲製與昆蟲傳播不同 insect-based 表示以昆蟲為原料；insect-borne 表示由昆蟲傳播，例如疾病。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An insect-based snack contains insect ingredients; an insect-borne disease is spread by insects.
